parsed.why: Transition itself criminalised under Art. 390; coordinated witch-hunt with 40+ arrests, 16 imprisoned, judges sanctioned for acquittals. State is perpetrator; an outed trans visitor faces near-certain imprisonment.

Decriminalised, no trans-specific criminal exposure, court struck down registration bar, incitement and homicide-aggravation statutes, broadly neutral society, no documented targeting. Resident gaps (no LGR, no discrimination law) don't reach the visitor.

Art. 319 enforced in mass arrests (99, 22 in two weeks), 2026 amendment criminalising promotion of transsexuality, torture in custody, corpse burned before crowd of hundreds; state complicit, no recourse.

Buggery ban upheld by High Court 2024; trans teenager charged with fraud for presenting as a woman; documented bias violence with no LGBT organisation, no SOGI protections, thin recourse. Criminalisation mostly sexuality-based but the impersonation charge reaches trans visitors.

Decriminalised since 1996, equal age of consent, no documented targeting or trans violence; negatives are resident-facing (no marker change, no relationship recognition) plus mild frontier document-mismatch confusion.
